title: Spellblades Spell Tweaks
description: Tweaks some spells from the Spellblades and Such mod.
body:
This datapack aims to balance or change some of the spells and spell coefficients from the [Spellblades and Such](https://modrinth.com/mod/spellblades-and-such) mod.

Some of the changes include nerfing three of the physical spells for Pillar of the Monkey King and slightly buffing the 2nd one, aiming to balance it out.

Made for the [Prominence™ II: Hasturian Era](https://modrinth.com/modpack/prominence-2-fabric) modpack.
